metadata.title: Abemaciclib with endocrine therapy – adjuvant
metadata.indication: Abemaciclib with endocrine therapy for eligible HR-positive, HER2-negative, node-positive early breast cancer at high risk of recurrence.

validation.source_method: Official web-extracted NCCP PDF text and page/table review; not an independent human clinical sign-off.

metadata.partial_assessment_note: Only entered values are assessed; omitted clinical domains remain explicitly unassessed.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

haematological_toxicity_grade.label: Haematological toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 0 — no toxicity
options.description: No clinical or laboratory evidence of toxicity.

options.label: Grade 1 — mild
options.description: Mild or asymptomatic; observation only; intervention generally not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — moderate
options.description: Moderate; minimal/local/non-invasive intervention indicated; limits instrumental ADL.

options.label: Grade 3 — severe
options.description: Severe or medically significant; admission may be indicated; limits self-care ADL.

options.label: Grade 4 — life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

haematological_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Use the specific CTCAE laboratory term and numerical result rather than a generic grade whenever the protocol provides an explicit blood-count threshold.

diarrhoea_grade.label: Diarrhoea grade

options.label: Grade 0 — no diarrhoea
options.description: No increase above the patient's usual stool frequency or ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 1 — <4 stools/day over baseline
options.description: Increase of fewer than 4 stools per day above baseline, or mild increase in ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 2 — 4–6 stools/day over baseline; limits instrumental ADL
options.description: Increase of 4–6 stools per day above baseline, or moderate increase in ostomy output; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3 — ≥7 stools/day over baseline, incontinence or admission indicated; limits self-care ADL
options.description: Increase of 7 or more stools per day above baseline, incontinence, hospital care indicated, or severe ostomy-output increase; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4 — life-threatening; urgent intervention required
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: Count stools per day above the patient's baseline, assess ostomy output, continence, hydration, fever, abdominal pain, haemodynamic compromise and whether hospital care is indicated.

alt_grade.label: ALT elevation grade

options.label: Grade 0 — normal
options.description: ALT/AST within the applicable reference range or without a treatment-emergent increase.

options.label: Grade 1 — >ULN to 3 × ULN
options.description: If baseline normal: above ULN to 3 ×ULN. If baseline abnormal: 1.5 to 3 × baseline.

options.label: Grade 2 — >3 to 5 × ULN
options.description: If baseline normal: above 3 to 5 ×ULN. If baseline abnormal: above 3 to 5 × baseline.

options.label: Grade 3 — >5 to 20 × ULN
options.description: If baseline normal: above 5 to 20 ×ULN. If baseline abnormal: above 5 to 20 × baseline.

options.label: Grade 4 — >20 × ULN
options.description: If baseline normal: above 20 ×ULN. If baseline abnormal: above 20 × baseline.

alt_grade.assessment_guidance: Use the measured ALT/AST and laboratory ULN; account for an abnormal baseline where CTCAE specifies a baseline-relative definition. Assess bilirubin and alternative causes concurrently.

options.label: Grade 3 — >5 to 20 × ULN

options.label: Grade 4 — >20 × ULN

ild_grade.label: Confirmed ILD/pneumonitis grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No pneumonitis.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Symptomatic; medical intervention indicated; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms; oxygen indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening respiratory compromise; urgent intervention such as ventilatory support required.

ild_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess new cough, dyspnoea, oxygen saturation/requirement, imaging, infection and alternative causes. Symptomatic suspected pneumonitis requires prompt senior review.

other_toxicity_grade.label: Other non-haematological toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No other non-haematological adverse event.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Grade 2 under the named CTCAE term: generally moderate; local/non-invasive intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Grade 3 under the named CTCAE term: severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

other_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Name the exact non-haematological adverse event first and apply its own CTCAE v5.0 criterion. The displayed general severity anchors are a screening aid only, not a substitute for the named term.

output_templates.consultant_review: The entered result lies in a phase-dependent or non-deterministic range. Confirm the treatment phase and review the official NCCP protocol.

rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Evaluate only supplied values. Do not infer missing values and do not block a partial assessment.

action.recommendation: Check adjuvant entry criteria: definitive surgery, high-risk node-positive disease, initiation within 16 months of resection and the source endocrine-treatment timing limit. Do not substitute an Oncotype score for these criteria.

action.recommendation: Suspend abemaciclib until blood toxicity recovers to grade ≤2. First grade 3 permits the same dose; recurrent grade 3 or grade 4 needs the next lower dose after recovery. No restart dose is calculated while toxicity is active.

rules.explanation: Suspend abemaciclib until blood toxicity recovers to grade ≤2. First grade 3 permits the same dose; recurrent grade 3 or grade 4 needs the next lower dose after recovery. No restart dose is calculated while toxicity is active.

action.recommendation: After verified recovery from recurrent grade 3, select the next lower dose using the actual prior dose and review all blood-count domains.

rules.explanation: After verified recovery from recurrent grade 3, select the next lower dose using the actual prior dose and review all blood-count domains.

action.recommendation: Allow at least 48 hours after the last growth-factor dose AND recovery to grade ≤2. At restart use the next lower dose unless this toxicity already prompted reduction.

rules.explanation: Allow at least 48 hours after the last growth-factor dose AND recovery to grade ≤2. At restart use the next lower dose unless this toxicity already prompted reduction.

action.recommendation: Interrupt abemaciclib, assess hydration/infection and treat diarrhoea. After recovery to grade ≤1, restart at the next lower dose with the team.

rules.explanation: Interrupt abemaciclib, assess hydration/infection and treat diarrhoea. After recovery to grade ≤1, restart at the next lower dose with the team.

action.recommendation: Interrupt unresolved grade 2 diarrhoea at 24 hours or persistent/recurrent grade 2 despite support. First episode may resume at the same dose after recovery; persistent/recurrent toxicity needs reduction.

rules.explanation: Interrupt unresolved grade 2 diarrhoea at 24 hours or persistent/recurrent grade 2 despite support. First episode may resume at the same dose after recovery; persistent/recurrent toxicity needs reduction.

action.recommendation: Establish duration and recurrence now; start the prescribed antidiarrhoeal/fluid plan. Do not assume the 24-hour interruption threshold has or has not been reached.

rules.explanation: Establish duration and recurrence now; start the prescribed antidiarrhoeal/fluid plan. Do not assume the 24-hour interruption threshold has or has not been reached.

action.recommendation: Interrupt until transaminases recover to baseline or grade 1; then use the next lower dose. Grade 4 and combined bilirubin criteria require discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Interrupt until transaminases recover to baseline or grade 1; then use the next lower dose. Grade 4 and combined bilirubin criteria require discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Grade 4 transaminase toxicity requires discontinuation of abemaciclib.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 transaminase toxicity requires discontinuation of abemaciclib.

action.recommendation: Combined ALT/AST and bilirubin elevation requires urgent liver-injury assessment; confirm cholestasis status.

rules.explanation: Combined ALT/AST and bilirubin elevation requires urgent liver-injury assessment; confirm cholestasis status.

action.recommendation: ALT/AST >3 ×ULN with bilirubin >2 ×ULN without cholestasis meets the source discontinuation criterion.

rules.explanation: ALT/AST >3 ×ULN with bilirubin >2 ×ULN without cholestasis meets the source discontinuation criterion.

action.recommendation: Discontinue abemaciclib for grade 3–4 ILD/pneumonitis and arrange urgent assessment.

rules.explanation: Discontinue abemaciclib for grade 3–4 ILD/pneumonitis and arrange urgent assessment.

action.recommendation: Persistent/recurrent grade 2 ILD not resolving with maximal support within seven days requires interruption; consider a lower dose only after recovery and specialist review.

rules.explanation: Persistent/recurrent grade 2 ILD not resolving with maximal support within seven days requires interruption; consider a lower dose only after recovery and specialist review.

action.recommendation: Suspend abemaciclib for VTE of any grade, treat the event and consider resumption only when clinically stable.

rules.explanation: Suspend abemaciclib for VTE of any grade, treat the event and consider resumption only when clinically stable.

action.recommendation: Interrupt; after recovery to grade ≤1, the source calls for the next lower dose.

rules.explanation: Interrupt; after recovery to grade ≤1, the source calls for the next lower dose.

action.recommendation: Child–Pugh C changes abemaciclib frequency to once daily. Confirm the current tablet strength and concurrent toxicity/interaction adjustments; do not simply halve a displayed twice-daily dose.

rules.explanation: Child–Pugh C changes abemaciclib frequency to once daily. Confirm the current tablet strength and concurrent toxicity/interaction adjustments; do not simply halve a displayed twice-daily dose.

action.recommendation: NCCP Table 3 expects no renal dose adjustment even below CrCl 30 or on haemodialysis. Evidence is limited; confirm renal status and suitability with oncology/pharmacy rather than automatically reduce.

rules.explanation: NCCP Table 3 expects no renal dose adjustment even below CrCl 30 or on haemodialysis. Evidence is limited; confirm renal status and suitability with oncology/pharmacy rather than automatically reduce.

action.recommendation: Prefer avoiding strong CYP3A inhibitors. If unavoidable, apply the source current-dose-specific adjustment with pharmacy; 50 mg twice daily needs individual monitoring, once-daily dosing or discontinuation consideration.

rules.explanation: Prefer avoiding strong CYP3A inhibitors. If unavoidable, apply the source current-dose-specific adjustment with pharmacy; 50 mg twice daily needs individual monitoring, once-daily dosing or discontinuation consideration.

action.recommendation: The 48-hour interval alone does not establish recovery. Confirm haematological grade ≤2 and actual prior dose before restarting.

rules.explanation: The 48-hour interval alone does not establish recovery. Confirm haematological grade ≤2 and actual prior dose before restarting.

action.recommendation: Establish persistence, treatment response and duration of symptomatic grade 2 ILD; assess promptly with the treating team.

rules.explanation: Establish persistence, treatment response and duration of symptomatic grade 2 ILD; assess promptly with the treating team.

supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
premedication_summary: Routine scheduled antiemetic premedication is not usually required.
Provide rescue antiemetic where clinically indicated.
other_supportive_care: Proactive diarrhoea education and access to loperamide according to local policy.
Prompt contact at first loose stool and maintain hydration.
supportive_care.mapping_basis: Oral SACT classification from NCCP V6 Table 8.

ctcae_standard.reference: CTCAE grading as cited by the NCCP source protocol
ctcae_standard.display_requirement: Every grade-based input includes toxicity-specific criteria and practical assessment guidance.

administration.notes: Continuous for up to two years, with prescribed endocrine therapy. The 28-day block is for review, not a tablet break.
